sentences.en: My father has a ranch and breeds cattle and horses.
sentences.zh: 我父亲有一个牧场，养牛和马。

sentences.en: They were encouraged not to let their cattle roam freely.
sentences.zh: 他们被鼓励不要让牛随意游荡。

sentences.en: Because of the famine, the cattle starved to death.
sentences.zh: 由于饥荒，这些牛饿死了。

senses.zh: （总称）牛，牲口,畜生,无价值的人,〈美俚〉女学生
